title: Generative AI for Software Developers
overview: This course is designed for software developers, engineers, and architects who want to leverage Generative AI for code generation, debugging, optimization, and automation.
AI-assisted coding with tools like GitHub Copilot, Chat-GPT, and Code Llama.
Using Generative AI for code refactoring, debugging, and testing.
Automating documentation, API development, and software design.
Enhancing DevOps workflows with AI-powered automation.
Understanding the ethical implications of AI in software development
By the end of the course, participants will be able to integrate Generative AI into their development workflow, improving productivity, code quality, and automation.
audience: Basic proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Java, or other programming languages
Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps
methodology: This course follows a hands-on, real-world approach, including:
Instructor-led sessions with live coding demonstrations
Practical coding exercises using AI-assisted tools
Case studies on AI-powered development workflows
Capstone project: AI-powered development workflow implementation
competencies: By the end of the course, participants will:
Use Generative AI for faster, more efficient software development
Enhance code quality through AI-driven suggestions and optimizations
Automate repetitive development tasks (code generation, testing, documentation, etc.)
Improve debugging and software maintenance using AI insights
Leverage AI-powered DevOps tools for CI/CD and automation
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will:
objectives: Develop AI-assisted code using modern AI-powered tools
Use AI for debugging, code refactoring, and optimization
Enhance software documentation and test automation with AI
Understand the ethical considerations of AI-generated code
Integrate AI into DevOps workflows for enhanced productivity
